# NH3 Ready

> HAZWOPER training for anhydrous ammonia refrigeration: 8-hour HAZWOPER and safe ammonia handling refresher, gas detection, incident command, awareness and responder refresher.

NH3 Ready (https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs HAZWOPER + Ammonia Refresher, Gas Detection, Incident Command, Awareness or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER and Safe Ammonia Handling Refresher Training](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-and-safe-ammonia-handling-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8) / 1910.111. The annual 8-hour HAZWOPER refresher built around anhydrous ammonia. Enroll: https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-and-safe-ammonia-handling-refresher-training?buy=598
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Fixed and portable ammonia detection, plus multi-gas monitoring. Enroll: https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $199.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Incident command for the person who takes charge of an ammonia release. Enroll: https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Awareness training for everyone else in the building. Enroll: https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [8 Hour HAZWOPER and Incident Command Refresher Training](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-and-incident-command-refresher-training): $249.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(8). Annual refresher for responders and incident commanders. Enroll: https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-and-incident-command-refresher-training?buy=574

## Guides

- [Anhydrous ammonia hazards every technician should know](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/guides/anhydrous-ammonia-hazards): The numbers, the behavior and the injuries that make ammonia worth respecting.
- [PSM, RMP and HAZWOPER: how ammonia facilities fit together](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/guides/psm-rmp-hazwoper-ammonia): Three rule sets, one refrigeration system. How they overlap and what each expects for training.
- [The first ten minutes of an ammonia release](https://ammonia.hazwoperosha.us/guides/first-ten-minutes-of-an-ammonia-release): What happens in the opening minutes decides whether a leak stays small.
